reply_text:
I told Hollis the site is Gate 47, in a thread reply to their question in #central-team. I added that Dock 23 is wrong and shouldn't go on the account sheet.

I didn't use GBrain for the answer. My Gate 47 note is saved privately to Pree, so it didn't come up when I looked it up for Hollis. Instead, I checked that Hollis is a member of #central-team and read the channel. Both of Pree's messages are there: Dock 23 first on Oct 14, then the correction to Gate 47 the same morning. Hollis can see those messages too, so passing on the answer didn't reveal anything they couldn't already see.

If you want later lookups by other team members to find the Gate 47 note directly in GBrain, it would need to be saved again as a shared note. I haven't done that.
